original_guide_quotes: This agreement is an openframework. An open framework allows suppliers to join at multiple points throughout its duration. This framework will re-open after 18 months and again at 36 months. This allows suppliers to submit new bids to refresh existing Digital Platform Items (service offers) and pricing, add new services, and allow new suppliers to bid to join the framework. An existing supplier who submits new bids, or a new supplier bidding to join the framework, will be assessed on the same basis as the first framework within thescheme of open frameworks. Any changes made will be reassessed.

hse_exact_release.description: HSE were looking for a supplier for Progress ShareFile, a secure file transfer solution for sending large data files to other organisations; which cannot be sent by email. The supplier was chosen via TePAs2 Lot 3 (RM6098).

scope: Resolve remaining checks only; no site candidate, deployment, demand or revenue verified.
